notes.title: Vote for ‘Interior Designer’ in the Steam Awards’ Sit Back and Relax Category!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Designers![/h2]

To all the talented creators who’ve transformed spaces in Interior Designer, your designs have made this game what it is today. [b]Every wall you’ve painted, every piece of furniture you’ve placed, and every bit of feedback you’ve shared has helped shape this experience[/b]. Now, it’s time to show your appreciation in a new way: by voting for Interior Designer in the Sit Back and Relax category at the Steam Awards!

[h3]Sit Back and Relax Award[/h3]

[b]This award is all about games that give you well-deserved rest after a tiring day.[/b] Interior Designer isn’t just a game - it’s a project fueled by community passion and the constant dedication of its solo developer. Whether you’ve spent hours perfecting every detail or simply enjoyed watching your spaces come to life, your vote will help highlight how much love and effort went into this game.

Let’s come together and make this dream a reality. [b]Let’s show the world how much this community cares![/b]

[h3]Fixes and further plans[/h3]
At the moment, we are looking into the analytics and trying hard to address any new crash reports. Please, check out the newest build released just 2 days ago :) We hope it will help you with some of the issues you mentioned in your reviews :) 

[h2]Thank you for being such an essential part of this journey. 
[/h2]Interior Designer team

notes.title: Hotfix and Patch notes: Fixes for crashes and more (Build 16259130)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Designers,
[/h2]The last 2 weeks were full of work! [b]We're trying to fix crashes and any bugs we notice[/b]. 
Here is the list with some of the recent fixes!

[h2]List of changes
[/h2][list]
[*] Updated links to use the new feedback form for the full game
[*] New Crash Reporter customized for Interior Designer
[*] Localization: Updated the Chinese translation for "Clear background behind the chair" so that it's less confusing
[*] Bugfix: Crash when deleting all the walls of a 3-way joint, when the roof is enabled
[*] Bugfix: Crash occurred if deleting a wall after its left and right neighbor walls have already been removed
[*] Bugfix: Importing a FBX model file would cause a crash
[*] Bugfix: When creating a new room over an existing staircase using the Create Room drag-drop tool, a cutout for the stairs in the floor would not be created
[*] Bugfix: Color and Material Picker was not restoring the original selection mode after picking
[*] Bugfix: After adding a new wall to connect 2 existing wall corners, undoing the action will leave cuts at the corners
[*] Bugfix: Creating a new room on an upper floor using the drag-drop tool will result in a room with a ceiling that is twice as tall
[*] Bugfix: On an upper floor, adding a wall and enclosing a new room will result in the new room's floor being set to ground level
[*] Bugfix: When creating a new wall connected to an existing wall, canceling the action would leave a cut in the existing wall
[/list]

We hope you will be able to enjoy the game even more now!

Best regards,
Interior Designer team

notes.title: Interior Designer Releases October 25th, 2024!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Designers![/h2]
Have you ever dreamt of designing the perfect home? Now's your chance! We’re excited to announce that[b] Interior Designer, a fresh and immersive home decor simulation, is launching on October 25th, 2024.[/b] Get ready to unleash your creativity and turn your design visions into reality!

[previewyoutube=8xzrpLEInow;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Craft, design, and innovate [/h2]
Interior Designer invites players to explore their imagination by designing interiors with a rich selection of furniture, materials, and decor styles. Whether it’s a cozy apartment, a chic urban loft, or a grand mansion, the only limit is your creativity! [b]Create custom layouts, experiment with various color schemes,[/b] and decorate every room to reflect your unique vision.

[h2]Realistic simulation meets artistic freedom[/h2]
The game combines the realism of detailed 3D models with the creative freedom that lets you[b] fully customize every aspect of your interior projects[/b]. From modern minimalism to classic luxury, you can create a personalized space that mirrors your style. Ready for a challenge? Take on client requests and design spaces that meet their tastes and budgets, or share your own creations with the community.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/

[h2]Wishlist today and join the design revolution[/h2]
Don’t miss out - [b]wishlist Interior Designer on Steam and be among the first to start decorating when the game releases on October 25th[/b]. Whether you’re a passionate designer or just looking for a relaxing creative outlet, Interior Designer offers endless possibilities to express your style.

[h2]And join us on Discord![/h2]
If you want to [b]ask the developer questions or simply share your artwork,[/b] join our Discord and talk about the game with the community!

notes.title: What you need to know about the Sandbox Mode in Interior Designer?
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Designers![/h2]

We are thrilled to give you more details about [b]the Sandbox Mode in Interior Designer! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/566d690c018ade48c4dd7afbbdb927d375a566d6.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is the Sandbox Mode?[/h2]

This feature allows you to [b]unleash your creativity without any limitations[/b]. Whether you're dreaming of designing cozy bedrooms, sleek gaming rooms, luxurious bathrooms, or state-of-the-art home gyms, Sandbox Mode provides a blank canvas for you to experiment and [b]bring your vision to life[/b].

In Sandbox Mode, you can access a vast catalog of furniture, decor, and architectural elements. [b]Some of them will be accessible only by playing through the Career Mode first[/b] and gathering Star Points which will allow you to unlock more and more furniture along the way. 

Play around with different layouts, colors, and styles to create spaces that truly reflect your unique taste. [b]The intuitive design tools[/b] at your fingertips make it easy to adjust lighting, customize furniture, and manipulate every aspect of your interiors effortlessly.

What's more, Sandbox Mode is not just about creating beautiful spaces - it's also a fantastic way to improve your design skills. [b]With no client demands, you can take your time to perfect your designs[/b], try out new ideas, and explore endless possibilities.

notes.title: Career Mode in Interior Designer
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Designers,[/h2]
We have more information on the game for you today. This time, we want to show you... 

[h2]The Story Mode[/h2]
In Interior Designer, [b]you step into the shoes of an ambitious interior designer[/b] starting from the humble beginnings of a small flat. The game's Career Mode intricately weaves a narrative that reflects the ups and downs of the design industry, drawing you into a world where creativity meets business acumen.
Your journey begins with modest projects, decorating cozy apartments and modern gaming rooms. As your reputation grows, so do the challenges. [b]Each project comes with its own set of clients, each with unique tastes and preferences[/b]. Your ability to listen, adapt, and deliver stunning results will determine your success in the competitive world of interior design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/1c15666331f7fc53bee5382a39509a621ab54df6.png[/img]

[b]Each quest has a set of requirements: some are mandatory, and some are optional[/b] - make sure they are completed if you want to please your clients. With every completed order, you will unlock more furniture to use in the next quests as well as in the Design Sandbox and Design League.

Apart from Career Mode, Interior Designer offers two other fascinating modes: Creative Sandbox and Design League. We will tell you more about them on another occasion.

[h2]The demo is still available[/h2]
Make sure to play the demo and share your feedback on it with us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/10a0c707a61bf5823f88a03efb136188d2d42490.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join Our Vibrant Community
[/h2]We believe that the Interior Designer community is one of the most vibrant and supportive out there. [b]Join us on our Steam Community Hub to share your creations,[/b] and exchange tips and tricks. We’re always eager to hear your feedback and see how your unique style shapes the world of Interior Designer.
Make sure to join our Discord server as well :)
[url=https://discord.gg/6axhxV6XbE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img]
[/url]

[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/

[b]Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey. [/b]We can't wait to see the stunning interiors you create and the unique stories you bring to life within Interior Designer. Your creativity is what makes our community so special.

[b]Stay creative, Designers!
[/b]Interior Designer team

We have decided to [b]record a special video for you with our developer's comments to celebrate the Interior Designer demo[/b]. Joshua will explain the idea behind the game, and show you how to get around. Watch the stream together with us [b]today at 6 PM CET[/b]! We'll do our best to answer all of your questions in the chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/4cb157cbc16fbf43db6e262527718731c5e8477e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Remember to leave your feedback[/h2]
At the end of the demo, you will find an option to [b]share your feedback on the game with us[/b]. Each opinion, comment, and note, whether it's praise or a critique, is valuable to us, so be honest and tell us what you like and dislike about the game.

[h2]Add it to your wishlist!
[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/

That's all for today!
[b]Remember: design is not a thing you do - it's a way of life!

notes.title: Interior Designer Demo is live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Designers,
[/h2]We're excited to announce that [b]Interior Designer is participating in the June edition of Steam Next Fest 2024[/b]. The demo was released on June 3rd and will remain available for you until June 10th at least (maybe a bit longer).

[previewyoutube=lIrYYqzoDVk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What can you expect?
[/h2]In our demo, [b]you will find the career mode with five quests and a brief tutorial [/b]on how to use various buttons and features. Therefore, we recommend playing it first, so you can learn how to move around the game.
Then,[b] head up to the sandbox mode[/b]. There, you can try to design a living room or a bedroom, plan your future interiors, and create a general layout of a house. 
Still, [b]the demo offers you a limited selection of furniture[/b]. In the full game, we will have about 900-1000 pieces of furniture available on the release day, and even more afterwards. We plan to offer various options for each type of room, starting with a bedroom and living room, and finishing with a bathroom, kitchen, and hall.

[h2]We care for your feedback!
[/h2]At the end of the demo, you will find an option to [b]share your feedback on the game with us[/b]. Please, give us 10 minutes to do it, because we want to hear what works well in the game in your opinion, and what should be improved or completely changed.

[h2]And add it to your wishlist!
[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844910/Interior_Designer/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

[h2]And join our Discord![/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/RFuhEwWqFb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932888/eb2fbcaa0c7ddaa5bd6dd8b1557247ebd3698f66.png[/img]
[/url]

That's all for today!
[b]Remember: design is not a thing you do - it's a way of life!
[/b]
Interior Designer team
